remarks: More photos to come once painting and refurnishing are complete! Experience the Compo Beach lifestyle while residing in this idyllic New England beach bungalow! Offering modern day amenities with ultimate charm. Deceiving in size from the outside, this lovely refuge is surprisingly spacious with high ceilings and multiple gathering spaces. From the roomy main Liv Rm with wood burning fireplace, to the large eat-in kitchen, to the dining area that comfortably seats 6 with a sunny bonus sitting area, there are plenty of places to reflect and relax. Available from the end of August through June, with some flexibility on the beginning and end dates. **Owners to use the home for themselves for 1 month, 7/15-8/15 (some flexibility) in summer. Home comes furnished (Pls note: a number of existing furnishings are in the process of being replaced over the next 2 weeks). The 3 cozy bedrooms are outfitted with a Queen, a Full and a Twin bed w/ 2nd trundle mattress.. There is also an outdoor shower, 2 separate outdoor changing rooms, a grill, beach chairs and bike storage for the warmer months. Not a better spot to spend your time! Garage available to tenant once replacement of furniture is finished. Window units are provided for air conditioning. Good credit and references are a must.
